question_text: What type of angle is formed between the clock hands at 4 o'clock?
step_by_step_solution: A clock face is divided into 12 equal hour divisions of 360° / 12 = 30° each. At 4 o'clock, the separation is 4 hour divisions = 4 x 30° = 120°. Since 90° < 120° < 180°, it is an Obtuse Angle.

question_text: An angle measuring strictly between 180° and 360° is called a ____ angle.
step_by_step_solution: By angle classification definitions: Acute (0°-90°), Right (90°), Obtuse (90°-180°), Straight (180°), and Reflex (180°-360°).

question_text: Calculate the degree measure of an angle formed by 7/12 of a complete rotation.
step_by_step_solution: One complete rotation = 360°. Angle in degrees = Fraction of turn x 360° = (7/12) x 360° = 7 x 30° = 210°.

question_text: The Ashoka Chakra has 24 spokes. What is the degree measure of the angle between two adjacent spokes?
step_by_step_solution: The 24 spokes divide a full circle (360°) into 24 equal central angles. Angle between adjacent spokes = 360° / 24 = 15°.

question_text: A student takes a square paper sheet and folds it along a diagonal crease, then folds it in half again through the vertex. (a) What is the angle measure of the corner before folding? (b) What are the angles formed after the 1st and 2nd folds?
step_by_step_solution: (a) The corner of a square sheet is a right angle = 90°. (b) Folding along the diagonal bisects 90° into two equal 45° angles. Folding in half again bisects 45° into two equal 22.5° angles.

question_text: How many degrees does the minute hand of a clock turn in 25 minutes?
step_by_step_solution: The minute hand turns 360° in 60 minutes, which is 360/60 = 6° per minute. In 25 minutes, it turns 25 x 6° = 150°.

question_text: A line segment has ____ fixed endpoints, whereas a ray has ____ endpoint.
step_by_step_solution: A line segment is bounded by 2 endpoints; a ray originates at 1 endpoint and extends infinitely in one direction.

question_text: Classify the following angles by degree measure: (1) 35°, (2) 115°, (3) 245°.
correct_answer: (1) Acute Angle, (2) Obtuse Angle, (3) Reflex Angle
step_by_step_solution: 35° is between 0° and 90° (Acute); 115° is between 90° and 180° (Obtuse); 245° is between 180° and 360° (Reflex).

question_text: Compass Bearings: A ship changes heading from Due East (90°) to South-West (225°) clockwise. Calculate the total angle of rotation and its fractional turn.
step_by_step_solution: Angle of rotation = 225° - 90° = 135°. Fractional turn = 135 / 360 = 3/8 turn.

question_text: Architectural Roof Truss: A triangular roof truss has a top apex angle of 110° and two equal base angles. (a) Classify the apex angle. (b) Find the measure of each base angle given that the sum of angles in a triangle is 180°.
step_by_step_solution: (a) 110° is strictly between 90° and 180°, so it is an Obtuse Angle. (b) Sum of two equal base angles = 180° - 110° = 70°. Each base angle = 70° / 2 = 35°.
